static_traits.name: Chen Ming
static_traits.social_status: 有少数朋友但not愿谈及Self-doubt;与姐姐关系受影响;多数客户满意且有回头客
static_traits.medical_history: without重要躯体疾病;not yet接受过心理治疗;既往without类似心理问题
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰,思路连贯,配合度高;能够自我观察思维模式;常use绝对化与标签化表述(如'永远not够好');倾向negate正向反馈与成就;Work情境中伴随Anxiety与自我批评

basic_info.main_problem: 因姐姐对我为她做的妆容not满意,我开始对自己的Makeup artistskill产生强烈的Self-doubt与not足感,并将一次负面反馈泛化到整体能力,影响Work时的信心与表现.
basic_info.core_demands: 寻求咨询的支持与指导,以挑战并重构消极信念,缓解Self-doubt,Recovery作为Makeup artist的职业自信.

special_situations.event: 姐姐对我为她做的妆容表达not满,指出妆感not均匀,not是她的Anticipation
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果重要的亲人都not喜欢我的作品,就证明我整体能力not足,说明我是个坏Artist
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Proves herself and avoids making mistakes again by doubling practice and watching online tutorials
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am just a terrible makeup artist

special_situations.event: Each time starting to do makeup for a new client
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果客户not完全满意,就意味着我失败;我必须让每位客户都满意
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 在Work中高度Self-monitoring,追求完美以避免not满
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会not满意,我可能会搞砸

special_situations.event: Receiving positive feedback from clients or seeing repeat customers
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 他人的赞美not代表真实能力,可能只是礼貌,not足以说明我真的有水平
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate成功经验,继续加练以弥补所谓not足
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are just being polite; I am just lucky

special_situations.event: 反复Recalling sister's negative evaluations并因此Relationship tension
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果让家人失望,就说明我not用且这是我的错误
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避与朋友讨论not安,Reduced socializing以避免被评价
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I disappointed her; it is all my fault

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and affirmed by significant others (family and clients)
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被negate,Being rejected与失败,担心让亲人失望
defense_goal: 通过Self-monitoring与negate正向证据来避免受伤与再次被negate
保持谨慎与自我苛责以获得控制感,降低not确定性

object_relations.self_representation: 让人失望,not够好的兄弟与专业人士
object_relations.object_representation: 苛刻且not满足的评价者(姐姐)

object_relations.self_representation: not合格,容易失败的服务提供者

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor emphasizes positive evidence or encourages accepting positive feedback
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为他人的赞美not真实,只是礼貌;体验到他人忽视事实或过度乐观
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responds in a questioning and reserved tone, emphasizing 'they are just being polite', downplaying positive evidence, and avoiding emotional involvement.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When starting work for a new client and facing possible evaluation and feedback
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将部分not满视为全面失败,认为只要not是完美就是彻底not行(全好全坏)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use绝对化陈述(如'要么完美要么失败'),语气紧张,倾向Self-deprecation并加大Self-monitoring.

manifestations: One piece of negative feedback in an intimate relationship is given great significance, repeatedly and intrusively recalled
At work, often feels the pressure of bearing others' evaluations alone

contact_model.definition: 个体存在not良的自我Reflection与过度自我限制,苛责,对接触过于小心谨慎
manifestations: Excessive worry and self-scrutiny when starting with new clients
将注意力聚焦在错误与not足

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others
manifestations: 预设他人会not满意,把not安归因为他人态度

contact_model.definition: Turning energy originally directed outward toward oneself, restraining making demands or expressing to others
manifestations: not与朋友谈论not安与Self-doubt,选择独自承受

positive_force: Objective evidence that most clients are satisfied with the works and there are returning clients
主动练习与观看在线教程以提升skill
Willing to seek professional counseling; positive attitude
Holding professional certification and work experience in makeup artistry
negative_force: negate正向反馈的习惯使成功难以内化
对not yet来的负面预测与读心术加剧WorkAnxiety
Self-worth strongly dependent on external evaluation (seeking external validation)

target_behavior.behavior: 开始为新客户化妆时出现Significant anxiety与Self-denial,Anticipation客户将not满意
target_behavior.core_reason: 将一次亲密他人的负面反馈过度概括为整体能力not足,并以外部评价决定自我价值(寻求外部验证)
target_behavior.function: 通过提前担忧与高度Self-monitoring来逃避被negate的可能,寻求控制以降低not确定性
target_behavior.consequence: Work效率与Decreased confidence,Increased stress,客户互动紧张,Daily life affected

target_behavior.behavior: negate正向反馈(认为他人只是礼貌或自己只是走运),难以内化成功经验
antecedent: When repeat customers or positive reviews appear
target_behavior.core_reason: Maintains a negative self-schema to avoid being disappointed again after expectations rise
target_behavior.function: 降低期望以缓解Anxiety,避免情绪受挫
target_behavior.consequence: Self-efficacy难以提升,Persistent self-doubt与职业Damaged confidence
